items.title: Bank of Baroda Q4 update: PSU lender reports 14% YoY growth in global business; deposits rise 12%
items.description: State-owned Bank of Baroda reported a 14% year-on-year rise in global business to Rs 30.78 lakh crore in Q4FY26, led by steady growth in deposits. Global deposits increased 12%, while domestic deposits rose 13%. The figures are provisional and part of the bank’s quarterly update, with final audited numbers to be announced alongside its earnings release.
